body: We introduce a novel method for verifying Lean formalizations that goes beyond LLM-judged faithfulness. Unlike most verification methods, which rely on LLMs or trained models, our method combines LLM-based semantic review with mechanical numerical and vacuity checks, providing checkable feedback and detecting errors missed by LLM judges. We apply this method, along with our Extract-Verify-Proof autoformalization pipeline, to construct the Formalized Library of Mathematical Functions (FLMF), a partial formalization of the NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF). On three labeled datasets, our method achieves the lowest accepted-error rate among the evaluated methods, measured as the fraction of incorrect statements accepted by the verification method. Expert review of the results also identifies translation and source defects in existing datasets. Code available at https://github.com/annamei1/FLMF-Ch7ErrFunc-Release.git.
summaryZh: 本文针对Lean数学形式化验证引入了一种超越纯LLM判定 faithfulness 的创新方法。该方法将基于LLM的语义审查与机械化数值及空洞检查相结合，提供了可检查的反馈，并能有效检测大模型评判容易遗漏的错误。基于此构建了数学函数形式化库（FLMF），在多项评测中大幅降低了接受错误率。
